en: But now that I'm here there's this other thing, and another thing, and a new thing that I want, and now I can't decide on what to get!
I know the feeling. Worse than not being able to decide is the ever-increasing number of things you want to buy.
But tryin' to buy all of the different things I want would be crazy talk.
I've gotta save up more money.
You don't need to buy everything. It's better to buy only what you can afford.
I could buy any one of these things, no problem. Not bein' able to afford all of 'em is why I can't decide what to buy.
Which is the most important thing for you to have?
Hm. I can't really rank 'em in order of importance.
Why not? If there's something you need right now, or something available only for a limited time, you should get one of those.
Huh? But I want all of 'em now.
I'm not talking about what you want. I'm talking about what you need.
I mean none of it's particularly essential.
Oh, I see. Why don't you do whatever you feel like, then?
Don't say that. I'm in a bind 'cause I can't decide what I feel like...
Good grief.
Wait for things to get cheaper. If it's something new, put off buying it right away.
True. But by the time it's cheap, it'll be out of style, won't it? If I'm gonna buy it, I should do it now.
I guess that's true. So why not buy the thing that's most popular?
'Cause if I wait a bit longer, maybe somethin' better will come out. So in that case, I shouldn't buy anythin' right away.
Well, yes. But with that attitude, you'll never be able to buy anything. Why not decide based on whether you want it right now or not?
Huh? How am I s'posed to do that?
How am I supposed to know? Geez, could you be any more wishy-washy?
I could buy something for you.
Wow, really? That's so generous of ya, Akiyama-san!
Just one thing now, mind you. I can't afford to get you everything you've got your eye on.
Now, what should I have ya get for me? I guess the most expensive thing!
Oh, but if we're gonna do that, maybe we should go to a different store.
That's fine by me. But why?
'Cause the stuff here's all at bargain basement prices. If yer buyin' me somethin', we should hit up someplace more expensive!
Whatever you like, miss.
Ooh, I want some <Color:8>JANJAN Yakisoba Koku Sauce<Color:Default>. It's super tasty!
(Honoka-chan wants to have some <Color:8>JANJAN Yakisoba Koku Sauce<Color:Default>.)
Hmm... Not too sharp today, Uncle Kaz.
(I'm sorry, Haruka. I'll try to do better next time.)
Yes! You're awesome, Uncle Kaz. You really can do anything.
(We should be going.)
Thank you for playing. Would you like to play again?
Welcome. Which course would you like to play?
On the Beginner Course, aim for targets and score points to win a prize. You get ten balls. The six targets are relatively easy to hit.
Will you play the Beginner Course? It's 500 yen.
The Intermediate Course is like the Beginner Course. Aim for fixed targets and score points. You get ten balls, and the targets are harder to hit.
Will you play the Intermediate Course? It's 500 yen.
The Advanced Course has targets that flip over when hit, so you can't score off the same target twice. Hit them all to flip them back. You get twelve balls.
Will you play the Advanced Course? It's 500 yen.
The Pro Course also has targets that flip over when hit, so you can't score off the same target twice. Hit them all to flip them back. You get fifteen balls.
Will you play the Pro Course? It's 500 yen.
Will you play the Ranking Course? It's 500 yen.
Look, I don't run a charity here. Nobody gets to play for free.
Uncle Kaz! I want to see you <Color:8>get at least 650 points on Intermediate<Color:Default>!
(Haruka wants me to <Color:8>score at least 650 points on Intermediate<Color:Default>.)
Thank ya kindly. Enjoy yourself.
Oh? You're not playing? Please come again.
No, no. No one plays for free.
Which course would you like to play?
Oh hey, so by the way, I've been thinkin' about gettin' myself some new perfume.
Perfume? What sort do you usually wear?
Most o' mine got a citrus scent to 'em. I like it when the scent doesn't linger so long.
Hmm. So then you tend to wear perfume that you enjoy.
Well yeah, of course. Nobody's gonna wear a scent they don't like.
That's not true. You could always wear something that you think a man would like. That's a possible deciding factor, right?
Aw, yeah, I s'pose you're right. I never thought of it like that.
Why not buy something like that? Something that'll turn the head of any guy that walks by.
Nah, see, 'cause then other girls are gonna start talkin', sayin' I'm a tramp and stuff.
No, no. You're overthinking it. I mean, I'm sure you've never thought that about your friends.
Sure I have. All the time.
Strong perfumes are just like tryin' to attract guys. You don't wanna overdo it, or ya come off all trashy.
Aha. Women are complicated creatures.
What do you need perfume for?
I mean I guess just 'cause I wanna feel nice 'bout myself. I don't really care what guys might think of it.
Hmm. That's rather unusual.
Nah, I don't think so. Makeup's the same way, ain't it? It's not about turnin' heads. It's about lettin' yourself feel pretty.
I suppose that when it comes to how you dress, it's more important to feel good about yourself than it is to show off.
Yeah, see? So that's why I wear perfume I personally like.
I don't care much about how I smell. I probably smell like cigarettes.
That's so like you. Doing what you want because you like it, and not because of what other people are going to think.
Ain't nothin' wrong with that. I wear perfume that's got a scent I like. Don't ya ever feel that same sorta thing, Akiyama-san?
Me? Let's see...
For me, if I smell like perfume, I have to try my hardest to smell like cigarettes instead, to hide the fact that I've been to a cabaret club.
That ol' trick! That's the same reason my mom always thought my pop was cheatin' on her!
Well, since it takes a long time at places like a pachinko parlor to hide the smell of perfume, you still get yelled at for coming home late.
Hahaha! Akiyama-san, yer kinda pathetic! You should be way more confident. <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Oh, trust me, you don't know what you're saying. She's a mean one when she's angry.
I really want the <Color:8>Italian Perfume<Color:Default>. It smells so nice!
(Honoka-chan wants the <Color:8>Italian Perfume<Color:Default>.)
Good to see you again. Are you back to make sure you haven't missed any of the latest designs?
Oh no, nothing like that. I'm still wearing duds I bought a year ago.
This winter, the designs from last year are still popular, in addition to the new lineup.
Oh, really now?
Yes, sir. The British style from last fall and winter are still in style, as are longtime favorite fashion trends, such as classic styles from the sixties.
Now that you mention it, I guess I do see a lot of people wearing that sort of thing.
After a trend calms down a bit, you can tell if someone is fashion savvy by their ability to make last year's fashions work.
There's more to fashion than simply throwing oneself head first into the latest trends.
(So that's the state of this year's fashion. I could talk about that at the cabaret club.)
(This was fun. Maybe I'll do somethin' else now.)
Congratulations. You bowled a strike during Midnight Madness!
You got <Color:8>Master Ball<Color:Default>.
Here is your prize. We hope to see you again.
Welcome. Just the two of you today?
That'll be 1,000 yen for you two.
Uncle Kaz! Let's <Color:8>bowl together<Color:Default>!
(Haruka wants to <Color:8>bowl with me<Color:Default>.)
You're not beating me, Uncle Kaz!
Oh, okay. We can <Color:8>bowl<Color:Default> some other time.
Let's bowl together!
(Guess Kaguya wants to bowl with me.)
Sure, okay.
Now then, shall we begin?
(I don't got the money.)
Later!
See ya later.
That was so much fun! Please give me a call again anytime! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
This was so much fun! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default> I wish I could head straight home now! But I have to make sure nobody from Rose Hip sees me.
I'll see you later.
Your technique's amazing, Aniki! You gotta call me again sometime! <Color:255,200,200,255>⑮<Color:Default>
Welcome! What kind of game would you like to play today?
May I play against you?
I don't take prisoners!
Can I play a split game?
If you wanted to go bowling, we could have done it in Kamurocho. Why did you call me all the way back here to Tsukimino!?
(Guess I'll call up Gachita.)
Sorry for the wait! Come on, let's you and me get our bowl on!
Wow, this is so much cheaper than shopping online! Maybe I should start buying things here.
Do ya do most of your shoppin' online?
I do. Things like electronics tend to be much cheaper. I usually only go to a store if I want to check out the actual item for myself.
You buy stuff online without seein' it first? Yer just askin' to get scammed.
It's fine so long as you do your research first. Usually it's just a matter of checking to see if a retailer is legitimate or not.
Okay, but how can ya tell if the info you find is true or not?
I guess from experience? You wind up developing an instinct for something that might be suspicious.
And is your "instinct" any good?
I haven't been wrong yet, at any rate. All of my online purchases have gone through without any issues.
Ain't it just the stores yer buyin' from rather than you pickin' the good ones?
Well, perhaps.
Honestly, Saejima-san, I think you're a bit paranoid. I think you'll find online shopping is very safe, if you just give it a chance.
Maybe so. Still, it ain't just about trustin' the other party. I gotta make sure I can trust myself.
Oh? What do you mean by that?
I'm not good with all that internet stuff. I'd probably wind up buyin' the wrong thing, or gettin' too much of somethin'.
Haha! I suppose that's a legitimate concern. Maybe you should just give it a try sometime. It could be a learning experience for you.
I don't see what's so funny...
Seems pretty random. I mean, yer leavin' it to instincts. How're ya gonna be sure of anything?
I can't reach a decision any other way, so what's wrong with trusting your gut? Saejima-san, don't you act on your instincts?
'Course not! Like I'm gonna make life decisions off some funny feelin'?
There've been times I had to make a reckless choice, but only when I had to, and only for things I really believed in.
But other than that, I'd never put my life on the line without a good reason.
I feel like this conversation has taken a dark turn...
Still, if I went in with both eyes open, I probably wouldn't get angry even if I was duped. Geez, you're such an old man, Saejima-san.
Hmph. I think yer just too careless.
I couldn't do that. I'm no good at that sorta thing. I'd rather go to a store.
I like to see what I'm buyin' and ask lots of questions, so I don't get ripped off.
Wait, really? But Saejima-san, don't you think you're more likely to get duped that way?
Because whenever you're unsure about things, it really shows on your face.
Even if they had no intention of cheating you, they might think you're a sucker and wind up charging you a higher price anyways.
Hmm. I guess ya got a point...
That's why you should shop at reputable stores like this one, or shop anonymously online where you won't have to show your face.
Maybe I'll give it a shot sometime.
I may have had too much to drink. That <Color:8>Legendary Drinker of Ryukyu<Color:Default> might help.
(Guess Kaguya wants some <Color:8>Legendary Drinker of Ryukyu<Color:Default>.)
Welcome! Oh, wait a second. Are you under age? Sorry, I'm not allowed to serve you any drinks.
Or would you like to see our act?
No, thank you. I'm a little pressed for time.
Oh, too bad. Come by again and catch our act sometime, yeah?
Yes, please! I would love to see it.
Why, of course you may! Here we go!
How was it? Hope you come by again!
Welcome! Have you decided on your order?
Can I get you another?
Oh, too bad, so sad. Please do come again.
Been a long time, Shinada.
Huh? Who are you, old fella?
Who're you calling "old fella"? Looks like you haven't matured much since junior high.
Junior high? Wait, are you...?
You were a real hoot as a student. Wasn't it summer camp in your second year when you pulled that stunt in the boys' restroom⑬
